description: Change title, price, ISRC, lyrics, story or credits of one of the person's tracks. After publishing title, price, lyrics, story and credits can still change, the ISRC not, and the change waits until the person confirms it in the browser (you get a confirmUrl to give them). Credits replace the whole list. Only the given fields change.

credits.description: Up to 50 credits, replaces the whole list. Roles: vocals, instrument, composition, lyrics, production, mix, mastering, other

isrc.description: ISRC code, e.g. ATA012600001, null removes it. Only before publishing

lyrics.description: Plain lyrics, one line per line. Replaces synced lyrics

priceEur.description: Price of the single track in EUR (0-1000)

name: studio_track_update
title: Edit one of my tracks
